<style>
/* =========================================================
   nothing is ever black and white : gallery styles
   ========================================================= */

/* Hide the "AUTHOR" label above the name (keep the name) */
.quarto-title-meta-heading {
    display: none;
}

/* ---- Tabs: black and grey, no borders ---- */
.panel-tabset .nav-tabs {
    border-bottom: none;
}

.panel-tabset .nav-link {
    color: #888;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;
    margin-right: 2rem;
}

.panel-tabset .nav-link:hover {
    color: #000;
}

.panel-tabset .nav-link.active {
    color: #000;
    border: none;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #000;
    background: transparent;
}

.panel-tabset .tab-content {
    border: none;
    padding: 1rem 0 0 0;
}

/* ---- Tab _intros and About text ---- */

.tab-intro p {
    text-align: left;
}

/* ---- Links: black with a subtle underline ---- */
.tab-intro a {
    color: #000;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-color: #bbb;       /* light grey underline */
    text-underline-offset: 3px;        /* a little space below the text */
}

.tab-intro a:hover {
    color: #555;
    text-decoration-color: #555;
}

/* ---- Masonry gallery: photos at natural shape ---- */
.photo-grid {
    column-count: 3;
    column-gap: 12px;
    margin-top: 1rem;
}

.photo-grid p {
    break-inside: avoid;
    margin: 0 0 12px 0;
}

/* ---- Series tab: one labelled row of three per series ---- */
.series-label {
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    color: #555;
    margin: 2rem 0 0.5rem 0;
}

.series-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 12px;
    align-items: center;
}

.series-row p {
    margin: 0;
}

/* ---- Shared image styling ---- */
.photo-grid img,
.series-row img {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    display: block;
    transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
}

.photo-grid img:hover,
.series-row img:hover {
    opacity: 0.85;
}

/* ---- Footer (copyright) ---- */
.site-footer {
    margin-top: 4rem;
    padding-top: 1rem;
    border-top: 1px solid #eee;
}

.site-footer p {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: #888;
    text-align: center;
}

/* ---- About photo: beside the text on desktop, full width on phones ---- */
.about-photo {
    float: right;
    width: 260px;
    margin: 0 0 1.5rem 2rem;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
    .about-photo {
        float: none;
        width: 100%;
        margin: 0 0 1.5rem 0;
    }
}

/* Prevent the page shifting when tabs change length */
html {
    scrollbar-gutter: stable;
}

/* Switch tabs instantly: no fade animation */
.panel-tabset .tab-pane.fade {
    transition: none;
}

/* Smooth crossfade between pages of the site */
@view-transition {
    navigation: auto;
}

/* ---- Screen sizes ---- */

@media (max-width: 768px) {             /* tablets: 2 columns */
    .photo-grid { column-count: 2; }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {             /* phones: 1 column */
    .photo-grid { column-count: 1; }
    .series-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

</style>

```{r}
#| label: photo-gallery
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

# ---- Settings -------------------------------------------------------------

# Tabs appear in this order. Left side = folder name, right side = tab label.
categories <- c(
  zambia        = "zambia",
  series        = "series",
  architecture  = "architecture",
  street_people = "the street",
  landscape     = "landscape"
)

# ---- Read the caption sheet ----------------------------------------------

captions <- read.csv("photo_captions.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = "")
captions[is.na(captions)] <- ""

# ---- Check the sheet against the photos folder ---------------------------
# Any mismatch is shown at the top of the page until you fix it.

on_disk <- list.files("photos", pattern = "\\.jpe?g$",
                      ignore.case = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
in_csv  <- file.path(captions$folder, captions$file)

not_in_csv  <- setdiff(on_disk, in_csv)
not_on_disk <- setdiff(in_csv, on_disk)

if (length(not_in_csv) > 0) {
  warning("In photos/ but missing from photo_captions.csv: ",
          paste(not_in_csv, collapse = ", "))
}
if (length(not_on_disk) > 0) {
  warning("In photo_captions.csv but not found in photos/: ",
          paste(not_on_disk, collapse = ", "))
}

# Keep only photos that exist, in tab order, then CSV row order.
captions <- captions[in_csv %in% on_disk, ]
captions <- captions[captions$folder %in% names(categories), ]
captions <- captions[order(match(captions$folder, names(categories)),
                           seq_len(nrow(captions))), ]
captions$number <- seq_len(nrow(captions))

# ---- One photo, as Markdown with lightbox caption ------------------------

photo_md <- function(row, group) {
  desc <- paste0(row$number, ". ", row$title)
  if (nzchar(row$location)) desc <- paste0(desc, " — ", row$location)
  if (nzchar(row$credit))   desc <- paste0(desc, " · ", row$credit)
  desc <- gsub('"', "'", desc)
  alt  <- desc
  paste0("![](photos/", row$folder, "/", row$file, ")",
         '{group="', group, '" description="', desc,
         '" fig-alt="', alt, '"}\n\n')
}

# ---- Build the tabs -------------------------------------------------------

cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")

for (folder in names(categories)) {

  rows <- captions[captions$folder == folder, ]

  cat("## ", categories[[folder]], "\n\n", sep = "")

  intro_file <- file.path("_intros", paste0(folder, ".md"))
  if (file.exists(intro_file)) {
    cat("::: {.tab-intro}\n",
        paste(readLines(intro_file, encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n"),
        "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
  }

  if (folder == "series") {
    # One labelled row per series, in the order they appear in the CSV
    for (s in unique(rows$series)) {
      srows <- rows[rows$series == s, ]
      cat("::: {.series-label}\n", s, "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
      cat("::: {.series-row}\n\n")
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(srows))) {
        cat(photo_md(srows[i, ], paste0("series-", s)))
      }
      cat(":::\n\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("::: {.photo-grid}\n\n")
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
      cat(photo_md(rows[i, ], folder))
    }
    cat(":::\n\n")
  }
}

# ---- About tab ------------------------------------------------------------
cat("## about\n\n")
cat("::: {.tab-intro}\n",
    paste(readLines("_intros/about.md", encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n"),
    "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")

cat(":::\n\n")   # end tabset
```
